name: Stop Thief
steps: Drag the water to the sleeping man.
Open the cabinet and take the sandwich.
Drag the sandwich to the man.
Tap the trash can to reveal the cockroach.
Drag the cockroach to the thief.
Drag the hat to the sleeping man.
Drag the soap onto the floor.
Tap the – button until it reaches 16°C.
Catch the thief and complete the level.
